shortDesc.message: Hide private messages inside innocent public phrases. Encrypt and decode text right in Facebook, VK and Telegram chats.

storeDesc.message:
Secret Message turns a private text into an ordinary-looking public phrase that fits your conversation. Only the person who knows the workspace and password can turn it back into the original message.

Encrypt:
▸ Select the last messages of a Facebook post, VK post or web chat (Telegram Web and others)
▸ Click the extension icon, press Ctrl+Shift+Y or use the right-click menu
▸ A compact Secret Message widget opens right on the page – drag it anywhere, collapse it to a small pill when you don't need it
▸ The selected text is added to the conversation history and the topic is set to FB post, VK post or Web chat
▸ Type your private message and press "Encode message" – it is encrypted in the browser and turned into a natural reply that fits the conversation
▸ The public phrase is copied to the clipboard – just paste it into the chat

Decrypt:
▸ On Facebook, Messenger, VK and Telegram Web turn on auto decoding from the right-click menu or with Ctrl+Shift+L
▸ Hover over a message – the private text of a secret message appears right after it

Security:
🔒 AES-GCM encryption performed locally in your browser
🔒 Password + workspace protection
🔒 Optional owner signature
🔒 Settings are stored encrypted for each site; the message history is never saved
🔒 No registration, no account

Customization:
⭐ Choose the topic, style and language of the public phrase
⭐ Keep a conversation history so phrases fit the dialogue
⭐ Save, import and export your obfuscation settings

autoDecodingCommandDesc.message: Turn auto decoding of secret messages on or off
